task_criteria: install.sh --rule-pack <name> only accepts packs shipped in plugin/terminal_jail/rules/packs/. Add a new flag --rule-pack-file <path> that: (1) validates the pack with rule-pack-tool.py validate <path>, (2) byte-copies it to the resolved rules dir (same destination as --rule-pack), (3) adds a symmetric --uninstall-rule-pack-file <path> that removes the installed copy. Document both flags in README.md under the rule-pack section. Add a test in scripts/test_install.sh (or extend the existing install test) that creates a temp pack file, installs it with --rule-pack-file, verifies it landed in the rules dir, then uninstalls it. Run the test and confirm it passes.

COMPLETE
  ✓ install.sh --rule-pack <name> only accepts packs shipped in plugin/terminal_jail/rules/packs/. Add a new flag --rule-pack-file <path> that: (1) validates the pack with rule-pack-tool.py validate <path>, (2) byte-copies it to the resolved rules dir (same destination as --rule-pack), (3) adds a symmetric --uninstall-rule-pack-file <path> that removes the installed copy. Document both flags in README.md under the rule-pack section. Add a test in scripts/test_install.sh (or extend the existing install test) that creates a temp pack file, installs it with --rule-pack-file, verifies it landed in the rules dir, then uninstalls it. Run the test and confirm it passes.: (1) Validation: install.sh:983 runs `python3 "$pack_tool" validate "$pack_file" --pack-name "$pack_name" --rules-dir "$RESOLVED_RULES_DIR"` (pack_tool=scripts/rule-pack-tool.py, install.sh:850); live run printed "rule-pack-tool: pack 'my-pack' valid — 1 rule(s)". (2) Byte-copy: install.sh:987-988 `mkdir -p "$RESOLVED_RULES_DIR"; cp -- "$pack_file" "$pack_dest"` where pack_dest=${RESOLVED_RULES_DIR}/terminal-jail-pack-<name>.yaml — identical destination to --rule-pack (install.sh:889); `cmp` confirmed BYTE-IDENTICAL. (3) Symmetric uninstall: install.sh:326-333 parses --uninstall-rule-pack-file; install.sh:991-1006 rm -f the same dest; live run printed "removed rule pack file ..." and the file was gone (REMOVED-OK). (4) README.md:120-131 documents both flags under the rule-pack section ("Externally-authored pack files (--rule-pack-file)"), plus quickstart at README.md:87-88. (5) Test: plugin/test_install.py:1643-1671 test_rule_pack_file_install_then_uninstall_round_trip creates a temp pack, installs with --rule-pack-file, asserts pack.exists() and byte equality, then uninstalls and asserts it is gone. scripts/test_install.sh does not exist, so the existing install test (plugin/test_install.py) was extended as the criterion permits. Ran `.venv/bin/python -m pytest plugin/test_install.py -v -k "rule_pack_file or rule_pack_flags"` -> exit 0, "7 passed, 65 deselected in 2.74s". [resolution 0.04; install.sh, rule-pack-tool.py, README.md, scripts/test_install.sh]
All elements of TJ-DF-034 are implemented and verified: --rule-pack-file validates via rule-pack-tool.py then byte-copies to the same resolved rules dir as --rule-pack, --uninstall-rule-pack-file symmetrically removes it, both flags are documented in README.md, and the round-trip test passes (7 passed).
